subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the grouped action upgrades be approved for the workflows that handle secrets, publishing credentials, write tokens, and security-event permissions?
rationale: Automated review can verify immutable pins and compatibility signals, but only the repository’s security and workflow owners can accept the privileged execution-boundary change.

options.title: Approve after refreshed gates
options.body: Rebase the branch, rerun the complete security and workflow checks, and merge the grouped pins after secops approval.

options.title: Split privileged action updates
options.body: Separate Codex, token, CodeQL, and Docker publishing actions from routine setup-action bumps if the grouped rerun cannot isolate failures.

options.title: Hold current pins
options.body: Leave the existing revisions in place until an owner can review the upstream changes and operational impact.

recommendation.title: Approve after refreshed gates
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, rerun the complete security and workflow checks, and merge the grouped pins after secops approval.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly assigns several changed security-sensitive workflows to this team.
